legendaryActions.name: Legendary Action Uses
legendaryActions.text: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature’s turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendaryActions.name: Mind Invasion
legendaryActions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Mind Spike (level 5 version).

legendaryActions.name: Noxious Miasma
legendaryActions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 90 feet. Failure: 17 (5d6) Poison damage, and the target takes a −2 penalty to AC until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.text: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack. Green Hag Green Hag

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.text: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spell- casting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.text: The hag can mimic animal sounds and hu- manoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The grick makes one Beak attack and one Tentacles attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12) from all four tentacles. Griffon Griffon
